description:
Get verification status

Polls the current state of the regulatory verification for a number. Once a submission exists the state is read live from the registry and the stored value on the number record is updated to match, so this endpoint is what to poll after submitting. Before any submission it answers `not_submitted` for a number that needs verification, and the number's recorded state, normally `not_required`, for one that does not. When the registry rejected the submission, `rejectReasons` says why; it is null in every other case.
name: get_phone_number_verification_status
title: Get verification status
